_meta.description: Registry of the twelve shipped Fractures. This text is a compatibility contract, not a place to improve the prose.

policy.statement: A shipped Fracture stays as it is. New Fractures may be added, but shipped ids, triggers and effects are not edited.
policy.versioning: Each Fracture has its own version. A shipped id, trigger and effect are version-stable because community routes depend on them.
policy.speedrun_legal_semantics: On the Time ladder, speedrun_legal=true means the Fracture is legal. The Precision ladder bans every Fracture.

ladder_rules.time: Fractures are legal on this ladder.
ladder_rules.precision: Fractures are banned on this ladder.

fractures.trigger: Crossing the seam between two streaming cells during a load frame
fractures.effect: Zero speed loss, skips a checkpoint
fractures.description: A seam transition preserves momentum while bypassing a checkpoint. The line remains optional, and checkpoint state is repaired when the runner leaves the seam.

fractures.trigger: Leaving a downdraft at the exact frame
fractures.description: A downdraft edge transfers a larger launch impulse when the runner leaves it on the exact release frame. A slower exit remains available.

fractures.trigger: Contacting a wall within 2 frames of a slide start
fractures.description: A tight slide-to-wall contact can begin a repeatable boost chain. The boost is capped at five wall kisses.

fractures.trigger: Releasing a zip anchor within 3 frames of contact
fractures.description: A zip release made at anchor contact preserves more velocity than a normal release. The usual release remains a valid route.

fractures.trigger: Passing a closing Concord gate on the frame it starts to open
fractures.description: The first opening frame can leave a gate latched open for the runner. Waiting for a normal cycle provides the slower line.

fractures.trigger: Sliding along a wind regulator's exhaust vent
fractures.description: A regulator's exhaust grants a friction-free acceleration window while the runner slides along the vent. The vent can also be crossed without using the boost.

fractures.trigger: Re-grabbing a filament anchor during ascent
fractures.description: A second anchor grab during ascent repeats the pull at full force. One pull remains sufficient for the standard ascent line.
A buffered jump can omit the landing animation and preserve the timing window. The normal landing and jump sequence is unchanged.

fractures.trigger: Falling past a floor's collision LOD switch
fractures.effect: Passes through one floor, lands below
fractures.description: A fall through a collision level-of-detail transition can reach the floor below. Adjacent routes continue to land on the intended floor.

fractures.effect: +0.4 s of air control, no friction
fractures.description: Destroying a regulator drone during a spin grants a short air-control extension. Combat remains optional on traversal routes.

fractures.trigger: Triggering a sound cue on the exact frame of a section transition
fractures.description: A transition cue triggered on its exact frame is suppressed and does not interrupt the run. Normal cues still play on the ordinary transition frame.

fractures.trigger: Reaching Chapter 4's fracture site with all 11 other Fractures known
fractures.description: At Chapter 4's fracture site, knowing all other Fractures reveals the path used by the First Runner. The route unlocks THE SECOND FRACTURE ending.
